intent: A series of strokes recorded as one take, with the pen lifting between them.

device.conventions: PenConventions { RawUnits = TabletNative, Buttons = WintabEvent, Cursor = DeviceAssigned, Timestamp = DeviceTicks }

placement.units: desktop physical pixels, as reported by the session
placement.note: multiply by scale and add origin, per axis, for the surface pixel this was drawn at

aloftNote: Every reading taken with the tip up, unfiltered, including the packets that mean the pen has left range. Recorded to see what the recorder is choosing to drop. Not evidence about a stroke.
